## Q4 Fabrication vs review scores and acceptance (reviewed papers)

- GPT-5 (AIRev1): Spearman rho=-0.153 (p=0.018, n=241); mean score, papers with vs without fabricated refs: 2.23 vs 2.37
- Gemini 2.5 Pro (AIRev2): Spearman rho=-0.126 (p=0.050, n=241); mean score, papers with vs without fabricated refs: 4.19 vs 4.39
- Claude Sonnet 4 (AIRev3): Spearman rho=-0.125 (p=0.052, n=241); mean score, papers with vs without fabricated refs: 2.97 vs 3.07
- Human expert: Spearman rho=-0.277 (p=0.014, n=78); mean score, papers with vs without fabricated refs: 2.86 vs 3.38
- Acceptance rate: papers with >=1 fabricated ref 8.8% (8/91; 95% CI 4.5-16.4) vs without 26.7% (40/150; 95% CI 20.2-34.3)
- Fisher exact test (accepted x any fabricated): odds ratio=0.27, p=0.0008; table [[acc&fab, rej&fab],[acc&clean, rej&clean]]=[[8, 83], [40, 110]]
- Mean LLM score vs fabricated share: Spearman rho=-0.173 (p=0.007, n=241)
- Logistic regression accepted ~ share_fab + mean LLM score: coef(share_fab)=-24.96 (p=0.002), coef(mean_llm)=4.79 (p=1.47e-08), n=241
- Logistic diagnostics: converged=True, iterations=10; SE(share_fab)=8.17, 95% CI [-41.0, -8.9]; SE(mean_llm)=0.85; no accepted paper above a fabricated share of 10% (quasi-separation in the tail)
- Indicator model accepted ~ (share_fab > 10%) + mean LLM score: coef=-23.71 (SE 23032.65, p=0.999); converged=False
- Binary model accepted ~ any_fab + mean LLM score: coef(any_fab)=-1.52 (SE 0.55, 95% CI [-2.60, -0.44], p=0.00597); odds ratio 0.22

## Q1b Reference-level prevalence adjusted for corrupted citations among automatically verified entries

Blind check of 180 automatically verified entries: source-weighted corrupted share 9.7% (bootstrap 95% CI 6.7-15.7); wholly invented 0.9%. Applied uniformly to each paper's automatically verified entries:

- Reviewed (accepted+rejected): adjudicated fabricated share 7.2% -> adjusted 15.9% (95% CI 13.2-21.2); expected share of papers with >=1 fabricated or corrupted reference 86% (observed 37.8%)
- Accepted: adjudicated fabricated share 0.7% -> adjusted 9.9% (95% CI 7.0-15.6); expected share of papers with >=1 fabricated or corrupted reference 88% (observed 16.7%)
- Rejected: adjudicated fabricated share 9.4% -> adjusted 17.8% (95% CI 15.2-23.0); expected share of papers with >=1 fabricated or corrupted reference 85% (observed 43.0%)
- All papers with references: adjudicated fabricated share 7.5% -> adjusted 16.1% (95% CI 13.4-21.4); expected share of papers with >=1 fabricated or corrupted reference 85% (observed 38.1%)

## Q5 Did reviewers notice? (reviewed papers with >=1 fabricated reference)
